notes: Hard (18). A single ops scenario must produce three runnable deliverables plus an evidence bundle: configure.sh must repo-denies non-members while wiring an ACL whose default mask keeps group execute (deny + ACL reasoning), fixperms.sh must restore rwrx reads on shell scripts generically, mapper.py must implement a canon map and be verified against the example set on top, and dump.txt forces locating the live python process whose deleted-but-open source can only be recovered through /proc/fd before the embedded secret, suite pass-count, cProfile stats and verbatim terminal tail can be captured. The verifier re-runs configure.sh/fixperms.sh on hidden variant/edge/malformed scenarios and re-runs mapper.normalize on fresh inputs, so an overfit hard-coded script fails. Multi-tool breadth (procfs, setfacl, sshd, pytest, cProfile) plus the recovery stage chain carry the difficulty.
